question: Does resolving the first disputed World tick change useful native block behavior enough to justify more solver development?
comparison: PR77 source; existing World laws, a transient subdivision override for one 50ms tick only, then ordinary execution
decision: Exploratory value/sensitivity study, not a promotion gate or physical reference. A changed ending alone is not a benefit. Preserve adverse, inconclusive and censored cases; compare fine continuations and ordinary-ground control before attributing a benefit.
budget: Two existing native fixtures, two seconds each; no full suite or games. Stop kernel development during this study.
